about.lead: I am Munal Thapa, a developer from Kathmandu who likes solving design and technical problems together.
about.body: My work is focused on responsive websites, strong visual hierarchy, and interfaces that feel modern without becoming confusing. I care about the details that make a website feel polished the moment it opens.

focus.description: Layouts that stay clean from phone screens to large desktops.

skills.quote: I care most about clarity, flow, and presentation instead of complexity for its own sake.

experiences.description: Building responsive React interfaces and improving user-facing web experiences with clean component structure, practical UI polish, and reliable frontend workflows.
